g.text: Uniform nonpath chords; m/n = 32; no measured timing or work data
Round 1 reads m edges. Core-round inputs use aligned blocks b = 1, 2, 4, …, q/2; the final contraction leaves an empty quotient.
Markers include every defined input round; lines only connect that discrete expectation. Curves stop at their own final contraction.
These are ensemble expectations of one input-edge count per call, not measured scans, CPU work, memory or runtime predictions.
